== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Timer Mine (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — A timed bomb set by a mine-laying droid. Developed for blasting ore veins and spice mines, it has been modified for military use.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It "explodes" on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many opposing characters there are immediately lost; the opponent may choose who is lost. The timer mine is also lost at that point.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese deploys at a location card and explodes on your next turn. The English specifies a site and the beginning of your next turn. The Japanese lets the opponent choose who is lost; the English says the owner chooses.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-timermine.gif|Original English face]], [[Timer Mine (Dark)]].</ref>
